description: Look up the safety data sheet (SDS/MSDS) for a workplace chemical or product by name. Returns the product name, manufacturer, CAS number(s), EPA registration where applicable, a link to the actual SDS PDF, whether that PDF is manufacturer-hosted or a third-party copy, the revision date printed on it, the signal word and GHS pictograms when they could be read from the sheet, and a confidence level. If the product cannot be identified reliably it says so plainly rather than guessing — a wrong SDS is worse than none. Free, no signup. Use it when someone needs hazard or handling information, or the SDS, for a chemical they keep on site.

product.description: The chemical or product name to look up (at least 2 characters).

name: find_safety_data_sheet
title: Find a safety data sheet (SDS) for a chemical or product
